title: Box Drive synced folder
whyItMatters: Box Drive keeps a local copy of synced files in the user profile. Those copies can contain private documents even after the account is signed out.
source: Box Support, Box Drive frequently asked questions: the default Windows location is C:\Users\USERNAME\Box - https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/29475996910867-Box-Drive-Frequently-Asked-Questions
notes: The default location only. A Box Drive folder moved to another disk is not matched. Online-only placeholders are counted, not hydrated.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save and close open files, let uploads finish, and copy any Problem Item that cannot sync to Box to a drive you keep.
cleanup.signOut: In the Box menu on the taskbar, open the gear menu and choose Log Out, so Box Drive stops syncing this PC.
steps: Save and close open files and wait for uploads to finish.
Copy any file Box could not upload to a drive you keep.
In the Box menu, open the gear menu and choose Log Out.
Delete the Box folder named in the plan, then empty the Recycle Bin.
cleanup.risk: Box Drive removes its local files and offline copies on log out. Files that never uploaded are deleted; files in the Box account are untouched.
cleanup.source: Box Support, Using Box Drive Basics, Logging Out of Box Drive: https://support.box.com/hc/en-us/articles/360043697494-Using-Box-Drive-Basics
